The R84 physical XYZRHW vertex transform invokes ProjectPixelPair with one latched stereo pair and atomically applies post-projection pause vertical displacement to both eyes, preserving the original GPU vertex Z/RHW/colour/UV and leaving Quest3 compositor and R26_SAFE separately protected.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The R84 R30ConfigureXyzrhwWorldEffect dispatches original pause menu queued overlay and exact ScreenHud into the stage-extension XYZRHW eye-plane, which previously hardcoded R30HudScaleValue and no vertical shift even though ESC has VRPauseMenuScale and VRPauseMenuVerticalOffset.
source_trace: STATE_SMPAUSEMENU original game sprites retain ScreenOverlay2D/ScreenHud exact source ownership.
R30 finite-stage eye builder chooses an independent pause optical scale and scaled viewport offset only in original ESC pause scope.
R30 pixel projector writes both eye XY shifts atomically, with original D3D9 primitive and state backup/restoration; x64 OpenXR host receives stereo as before.
diagnosis.root_cause: The generic and exact ESC sprite families converged on a finite XYZRHW eye-plane implemented for +TIME/GOAL, whose scale selector ignored pause settings and whose post-eye pixel branch lacked the signed vertical displacement that the dedicated shader ESC path already used.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally rescale +TIME/GOAL, use HUD flat-FOV-only fallback, change game input/hitboxes, disable SKYGlow or lens, or force mono rendering to hide mismatches.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material C++ source change d23442bbcf034ac072b6b7be65fd6616129c112a updates the actual R84 finite eye-plane producer and bilateral pixel sink, adding portable helper and source-level executable smoke.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: vrhost/tests/stage_extension_eye_plane_smoke.cpp verifies negative, zero and positive ESC shifts, bad float input and overflow leave both eyes unchanged, and independent eye projector source remains intact.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: One exact original paused state controls both ScreenHud arrow and SpriteQueue overlay shell; two eye pixels share one latched OpenXR frame, independent pause scale and only pause-specific post-projection vertical shift; HMD runtime remains UNTESTED.
